name: Senba Uzuki
source:
Role: Oni Slayer
A girl with beautiful posture, conduct, and black hair, who came to Hemidzuka on the same train as [url=/c10490]Kei[/url]. Carrying an ancient katana - Ito - within a golden sheath, she is thought by those at the hotel to be connected with the Ohashirasama festival that will be happening soon in Hemidzuka.

[Taken from [url=http://akaiitotranslation.com/info/characters/uzuki.php]Zohar's site[/url].]
